vendor |quest_reward3_quest = Fallen from Grace |quest_reward3_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward3_act = 6 |quest_reward3_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Animate Weapon''' is a [[spell]] that animates a weapon on the ground as a [[flying]] allied [[minion]]. ==Skill functions== Animate Weapon can be used on identified melee [[weapon]]s lying on the ground. Bows and Wands cannot be animated unless the threshold jewel {{il|Spirit Guards}} is being used. Animated weapons are permanently consumed and cannot be recovered. If the "Key Pickup" option is enabled in the UI tab of the Options menu, the "Highlight items and objects" key may be held in order to animate specific weapons. Otherwise, the skill will attempt to animate a random valid weapon within a small area around the player's cursor. Attempting to animate a weapon with a [[level requirement]] higher than the maximum listed on the gem will cost mana and perform the cast animation, but will fail to create a minion. Animate Weapon can also be used on [[Lingering Blade]]s left behind by {{il|Bladefall}} and {{il|Ethereal Knives of Lingering Blades}}. Animated Weapons are [[minion]]s that are considered to be using the original weapon animated. They are therefore affected by modifiers to minions, as well as support gems for weapons, such as {{il|Elemental Damage with Attacks Support}}, but not affected by any of the player's passive tree for specific weapons. All modifiers on the weapon item itself apply to the minions once animated, including [[enchantment]]s, [[corrupted implicit modifier]]s, [[Scourge modifier]]s, and [[Crucible passive tree]]s (except modifiers which allocate player [[notable]] [[passive skill]]s, as minions do not have access to your passive tree). ==Interactions== *'''Loot Filter''' - Some [[modifiers]] on identified weapons can be highlighted by editing custom loot filters. When combined with sources that cause items to drop identified (such as {{il|Cloak of Tawm'r Isley}}), players can selectively choose weapons magic or higher-level weapon types, which are often stronger than random normal weapons or Lingering Blades. *'''Special benefits''' - Animated weapons can inherit special modifiers exclusive to [[Unique]] weapons. However, because the weapon is consumed on cast, the pros and cons must be considered. Alternatively, it may be possible to animate the weapon via {{il|Chains of Command}} instead, bypassing the need to obtain multiple copies of the weapon to animate. *'''Main Hand''' - Animated weapons always count as using their main hand for attacks. This is relevant for weapon bonuses that come from being used in a specific weapon slot, such {{il|Wings of Entropy}}. ==Calculating damage== There are different calculations for weapons summoned from items on the ground and lingering blades from spells. ===Casting on a weapon=== Weapons inherit the hit damage, attack speed and critical strike chance of the weapon they are summoned from. This includes any direct modifiers to base stats, such as {{c|mod|108% increased Physical Damage}}, which are factored into the base damage of the minion. The minion then gains additional Physical damage based on gem level, which is not scaled by weapon local modifiers. The additional damage for Lingering Blades does not apply to animated itemized weapons. Other weapon-specific stats found on the weapon (such as {{c|mod|Attacks with this Weapon Penetrate 12% Elemental Resistances}} or {{c|mod|25% increased Elemental Damage with Attacks}} are additive with similar sources of stats for minions. Note that modifiers to Minions on animated weapons will have no effect on the Animate Weapon minion itself, as Animated Weapon is considered using the weapon, and has no minions of its own. The only exception to this would be when animating {{il|The Scourge}}. ===Casting on a Lingering Blade=== Animated weapons created from [[Lingering Blade]]s have similar base stats to those of a {{il|Glass Shank}}.{{cite web|author=Path of exile announcement|date=February 27, 2020|title=Announcements - skill demo: blade blast|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2779779|publisher=Official Path of Exile Forums|accessdate=October 6, 2020}} The same formula is used as when it is cast on a weapon item, except that it also gains additional flat damage on top of the minion's inherent flat damage modifier.
